description: Minifix-type cam-lock housing with an open ribbed cage, rounded radial neck slot, spherical bolt-head seat, blind cross drive, optional seating flange and recessed direction marks.
source: Hafele UK 2014 catalogue pp. 294-295 supplies eight installation rows (12-34 mm panels, 15 mm bore and optional 16.5 x 1 mm rim). Analytic casting geometry is reconstructed from user-supplied minifiks kilidi.SLDPRT, a third-party 14.8 x 13.5 mm unrimmed model measured in SOLIDWORKS 2023 on 2026-09-10; its manufacturer SKU is unverified. Internal dimensions, cross-row extrapolations and exploratory web/neck variation are proportion; see NOTES.md.
